options.name: apply_state
options.description: Managed recovery state (SQL mode)

options.name: configuration_name
options.description: Name of the Data Guard broker configuration

options.name: connect_identifier
options.description: Oracle Net connect identifier for the database being managed

options.name: database_name
options.description: DB_UNIQUE_NAME of the database to manage

options.name: database_state
options.description: Desired state of redo transport/apply for a database

options.name: dgmgrl_as
options.description: DGMGRL connection privilege Used for both password and OS authentication

options.name: dgmgrl_connect_identifier
options.description: Connect identifier for DGMGRL (e.g. host:port/service)

options.name: dgmgrl_password
options.description: Password for DGMGRL connection If omitted (along with dgmgrl_user), OS authentication is used Credentials are passed via stdin (CONNECT command), never on the command line

options.name: dgmgrl_user
options.description: Username for DGMGRL connection If omitted (along with dgmgrl_password), OS authentication is used (/ AS SYSDG or / AS SYSDBA)

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the configuration or database should be enabled or disabled. Only meaningful when C(state=present) and C(mode_dg=broker). C(true) ensures the resource is enabled after creating/configuring. C(false) ensures the resource is disabled after creating/configuring. When omitted the enabled state is not changed.

options.name: far_sync_connect_identifier
options.description: Connect identifier for Far Sync instance

options.name: far_sync_name
options.description: Name of the Far Sync instance

options.name: force_logging
options.description: Enable or disable FORCE LOGGING (SQL mode)

options.name: fsfo
options.description: Fast-Start Failover state

options.name: fsfo_target
options.description: Target database for Fast-Start Failover When enabling FSFO, issues ENABLE FAST_START FAILOVER TARGET TO <target>

options.name: mode_dg
options.description: Data Guard management mode broker uses DGMGRL commands (recommended by Oracle) sql uses direct SQL and V$ views (for environments without broker)

options.name: observer_state
options.description: Observer state

options.name: oracle_home
options.description: ORACLE_HOME path (required for DGMGRL in broker mode)

options.name: output_format
options.description: Output format for DGMGRL (26ai supports JSON) json provides structured output (Oracle 26ai+)

options.name: primary_database
options.description: DB_UNIQUE_NAME of the primary database

options.name: primary_database_candidates
options.description: List of database unique names eligible to become primary Sets the PrimaryDatabaseCandidates configuration property Oracle 26ai+ feature, will warn and skip on older versions

options.name: properties
options.description: Dictionary of broker properties to set on a database Example: {'LogXptMode': 'SYNC', 'NetTimeout': '60'}

options.name: protection_mode
options.description: Data Guard protection mode

options.name: reset_tags
options.description: List of tag names to remove from the target object Uses EDIT <object> RESET TAG syntax (Oracle 26ai+)

options.name: state
options.description: The intended state

options.name: tags
options.description: Dictionary of tags to set on the target object Target is determined by database_name (DATABASE), far_sync_name (FAR_SYNC), or CONFIGURATION if neither is set Uses EDIT <object> SET TAG syntax (Oracle 26ai+)

options.name: validate_connect_identifier
options.description: Connect identifier to validate via DGMGRL VALIDATE DGConnectIdentifier Tests network resolution, connectivity, and service name validation Oracle 26ai+ feature
